description: This file provides utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for display purposes, ensuring consistent string normalization across the application UI.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts input strings to camelCase, handling delimiters like spaces, underscores, and hyphens. It also preserves the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts input strings to Title Case for display, normalizing delimiters and spacing, capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, while handling accented characters.
